Subject: Security review kickoff & scope clarification - Orion Finance

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the security review moving: 

- Scope to confirm: production integration (API), data residency (US), and auth/keys management.
- Attachments we need back: completed security questionnaire, and any network diagrams you can share.
- Stakeholders to loop: security (you/your team), legal (contract redlines), procurement (PO / invoicing), and the economic buyer (we discussed Sam Patel as the sponsor).

Proposed next actions:
1) We’ll send the security questionnaire and SOC2 summary (attached).
2) Please confirm systems in scope and provide a primary security contact for intake.
3) Let’s schedule a 45-minute kickoff next week to walk through the questionnaire and mapping.

If that works, I can send a calendar invite for Wed/Thu.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this started.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0182

Alex/Priya —

Attached is the security questionnaire (spreadsheet) and a short SOC2 summary. I’ve penciled in a kickoff for Thursday, 2027-05-13 at 2:00 PM PST — invite sent to the addresses on this thread.

Helpful intake notes on the questionnaire: 
- Tab 1 = high-level controls questions (SOC2, encryption, logging).
- Tab 2 = systems & network (please list SaaS services and any third-party integrations in scope).
- Tab 3 = personnel & access (SAML/SCIM usage, user provisioning).

Please fill Tabs 1–3 as best you can prior to the kickoff so we can focus the call on clarifications and evidence locations. If you expect IT/network teams to answer Tab 2, share with them directly.

Attachments: Orion_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx (stub), SOC2-summary.pdf (stub)

Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire + kickoff invite (Orion Finance)

Thanks Marissa — one quick clarification before the kickoff: can you confirm whether the following are in scope for the security review?

1) Our analytics pipeline (AWS account analytics-prod) that pulls aggregated usage metrics from the Redwood API — is that considered in-scope or out-of-scope?
2) The SSO integration: we plan to use SAML for provisioning; will you need access to our IdP metadata or just SAML metadata exchange?
3) Procurement timeline: we typically need a signed MSA + PO process which takes ~3–4 weeks after legal is happy. Should we expect Redwood’s standard MSA or do you have a redline-able template you prefer?

Also looping procurement: Sam Patel (cc’d on internal thread separately) will be our economic buyer.

Thanks — Priya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@orionfinance.com>; Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@orionfinance.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security questionnaire + kickoff invite (Orion Finance)

Hi Priya —

Great questions, answered below to help prep for tomorrow’s call: 

1) Analytics pipeline (analytics-prod): out-of-scope for the initial security review as long as no raw PII is forwarded to that pipeline. If the pipeline consumes only aggregated usage metrics, we’ll mark it out-of-scope but will note required evidence (data flow diagram). If you want it in-scope we can add Tab 2 details.

2) SSO / SAML: we only need SAML metadata exchange and confirmation of IdP provider (Okta, Azure AD, etc.). We do not need persistent access to your IdP. Document the IdP type and share metadata prior to the kickoff.

3) Procurement + MSA: Redwood uses a standard MSA (link below) which is typically redline-able. For expedited timelines we can provide an SOW + invoice first and add the PO after legal signs — we’ve done that for pilot deals. Expect ~3 weeks after both legal teams finish redlines for a standard MSA timeline.

Economic buyer: noted Sam Patel as sponsor — thanks for confirming.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Orion/Security-Kickoff-Notes and our standard MSA: https://legal.redwood.com/templates/MSA-v3.pdf

See you on the call.

Best,
Marissa
